visual_logic.surface_detail: Rugged, high-dome shell with individual 'scute' plates rendered in 'Rusty Iron-Orange' and 'Dirty Ochre', running continuously along its horizontal profile.
visual_logic.anatomy_focus: Strict side-profile view configured to display the animal's maximum horizontal length for accurate top-by-bottom size comparisons. Hero focus remains on the long, non-retractable neck covered in bony defensive spikes and the club-like, spiked tail oriented parallel to the camera plane.
visual_logic.facial_expression: Alert and somewhat grumpy; small amber eyes adjusted to face cleanly from a lateral perspective.

environment.ground: Damp, leafy forest floor near a riverbank with mossy limestone outcrops, leveled to keep the lateral outline completely measurable.
environment.biota: The Triassic ferns and curious early mammal (Vincelestes) are shifted entirely into the distant background layers to preserve a sharp, unobstructed silhouette line.

pose: The primitive stem-turtle is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, crawling horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original low-slung crawl with a sharply turned head is unrolled and stabilized into a flat, level, straight cruising path, extending its spiked neck, high-dome carapace, heavily armored limbs, and spiked tail end-to-end to cleanly track alongside the central UI measuring tape system.
